source: BDS 1.26.60.6 Linux, read from the running server's memory once it started (bds-runtime-dump skill): for each block type, the placement rule its getPlacementBlock follows (blocks sharing BDS's function share a rule; 'pending' rules need the world and are not ported yet) and the placement traits (cardinal or facing direction with its rotation offset, vertical half, block face) BDS applies in order. Blocks placed in their item's state are left out.
